Lift out half for the top.Add the cold rice, break up any clumps and fry hot with salt until it crackles.Fry the eggs and serve on the rice with the crisp garlic and spring onion.SweetsTita's silky leche flanSmooth caramel topped egg custard made with condensed milkHow to make it150g caster sugar6 eggs395g condensed milk (tin)370ml evaporated milk (tin)1 tsp vanilla extractMelt the sugar in a pan until deep amber and pour into a 20cm dish, tilting to coat.Whisk the egg yolks with condensed milk, evaporated milk and vanilla without making bubbles, then strain over the caramel.Cover with foil.Bake in a water bath at 160°C until just set.Cool, then chill overnight.Turn out onto a plate.DrinksCalamansi lime and honey coolerCalamansi juice, honey and sparkling water over iceHow to make it4 tbsp honey150ml calamansi juice3 limes1 mandarin800ml soda water1 bag of crushed iceStir the honey into hot water until dissolved.Squeeze the calamansi juice, or use lime and mandarin juice.Mix the juice and honey syrup in a jug.Chill until cold.Fill glasses with crushed ice, add the juice and top with cold soda water.Garnish with lime wheels.Sago't gulaman with brown sugar syrupMom and Tita are still bickering.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
